questions.stem_text:
Chemical substances released by organisms that elicit a physiological or behavioral
response in other members of the same species are known as

Sea divers are aware of a danger known as the "bends". Explain the physiological mechanism
of the bends.

options.A: Carbon dioxide bubbles forming in the blood causing acidosis
options.B: Rapid increase in barometric pressure causing the bends
options.C: Formation of helium bubbles in the bloodstream due to rapid ascent
options.D: Increased salinity in the water leading to dehydration and joint pain
options.E: Oxygen bubbles forming in the blood leading to hypoxia

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Carbon dioxide bubbles forming in the blood causing acidosis

questions.stem_text: All of the following play a role in morphogenesis EXCEPT

The polytene chromosomes seen in Drosophila silvarentis with the aid of a light microscope
are

options.A: multiple copies of a single chromosome
options.B: not visible even under a light microscope
options.D: produced by repeated rounds of nuclear division without DNA replication

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - multiple copies of a single chromosome

questions.stem_text: After CLASS--Is a voluntary public insurance program a realistic way to meet the long-term support and service needs of adults with disabilities?
questions.answer_explanation: While more than a quarter of the middle-aged adult population said they were interested in PAS insurance, actual participation would be highly dependent on premium rates. The current lack of publicly subsidized insurance for long-term care and personal assistance services remains a serious gap in the disability service system.

questions.stem_text: Nutritional assessment of gluten-free diet. Is gluten-free diet deficient in some nutrient?
questions.answer_explanation: The gluten-free diet has minimal deficiencies, similar to those present in the diet with gluten, with an improvement in the lipid profile by increasing the proportion of monounsaturated fatty acids to the detriment of saturated fatty acids.

questions.stem_text: Is atropine needed with ketamine sedation?
questions.answer_explanation: Ketamine sedation was successful and well tolerated in all cases. The use of atropine as an adjunct for intramuscular ketamine sedation in children significantly reduces hypersalivation and may lower the incidence of post-procedural vomiting. Atropine is associated with a higher incidence of a transient rash. No serious adverse events were noted.

questions.stem_text: Does frozen section alter surgical management of multinodular thyroid disease?
questions.answer_explanation: While FS was commonly used in patients undergoing thyroidectomy at our institution, in no patient over the last decade did FS correctly alter the intraoperative management. Given the time required to perform FS and the cost associated with it, we believe that routine FS should not be performed in these patients.

questions.stem_text: Learning needs of postpartum women: does socioeconomic status matter?
questions.answer_explanation: It is important to ensure that new mothers are adequately informed about topics important to them while in hospital. The findings highlight the need for accessible and appropriate community-based information resources for women in the postpartum period, especially for those of low socioeconomic status.
